en.name: GadgetNest
en.subtitle: Compare tech before you buy
en.short_description: Compare phones, laptops and parts on price and spec, and watch prices.
en.description:
GadgetNest is for the part of buying a gadget that happens before you buy it.

BROWSE AND COMPARE
Work through categories, open a product for its full specs, and put several side by side. GadgetNest marks which one is the better deal and says why.

PRICE HISTORY
A chart of what a product has cost over time, so "on sale" has to prove itself.

BUILD LIST
Collect the parts of a build in one list and keep the total in front of you.

SAVED
Keep the products you are still thinking about.

STRAIGHT ANSWERS
GadgetNest earns a commission on some outbound links. It does not reorder results because of it, and everything it stores stays on your device — there is no account and one button erases the lot.
